title: A morphism whose composite with a separated morphism is finite is finite
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $g\circ f$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and $g$ is separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], then $f$ is finite. In particular, a morphism over $Z$ between two schemes finite over $Z$ is finite (finite morphisms are affine, hence separated).
